title: coreopsis bigelovii
intro: Coreopsis bigelovii, commonly known as the Bigelow's tickseed, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Coreopsis bigelovii include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Coreopsis bigelovii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
